values: MediSens Downtime Reference Import — Phase 2 Template
Use this workbook to transcribe paper downtime records for later controlled import.
Phase 2 scope: Existing Patients, Initial Intake, and Vitals only.
Use existing patient_id values only; do not create patients or overwrite identity fields.
All examples are synthetic and must be replaced before an approved import.
Do not enter passwords, tokens, secrets, clinical system IDs, or data from real patients.
Assign one unique downtime_reference per paper transaction (for example DT-20260910-001).
Complete required fields highlighted in teal. Yellow cells are encoder input areas.
Keep consultation_date/time as the actual service date/time, not the later import time.
Use the same downtime_reference on Initial Intake and Vitals rows for one transaction.
Leave deferred sheets empty unless a later approved phase explicitly enables them.
Submit for validation; the server will resolve patient access, consent, attribution, IDs, audit metadata, and duplicate handling.
